name: Homespun Kitchen and Bar
subject: Booth and seating repair
body:
Hi Homespun Kitchen and Bar team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather repair shop in Lakeway. We repair and reupholster restaurant booths, banquettes and bar stools, usually overnight or on a day you're closed.

If any of your seating is torn or worn, send me a couple of photos and I'll get back to you with a price the same day.

Dillon
(737) 247-7484
dillon@lerega.com

name: Sage Hill Inn & Spa
subject: Furniture reupholstery
body:
Hi Sage Hill Inn & Spa team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather repair shop in Lakeway. We reupholster lobby furniture, banquet and guest-room chairs, and restore leather pieces. We can work in small batches so rooms and event spaces stay open.

If you have pieces that need work, I'd be glad to stop by and take a look. The estimate is free.

Dillon
(737) 247-7484
dillon@lerega.com

name: Kim's Cleaners
subject: Handbag repair and cleaning
body:
Hi Kim's Cleaners team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, a handbag and leather repair studio in Lakeway. Your customers could drop off handbags and leather items at your counter, and we'd pick them up, repair or clean them and bring them back. You'd earn a commission on every order.

Could I stop by sometime and walk you through it? It takes about ten minutes.

Dillon
(737) 247-7484
dillon@lerega.com

name: Unicorn Moving & Storage
subject: Repair for furniture damaged in moves
body:
Hi Unicorn Moving & Storage team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather furniture repair shop in Lakeway. When a customer's sofa or chair gets torn or scuffed in a move, repairing it is usually cheaper than paying out the claim. We turn things around quickly and can pick up.

Could I send our contact to whoever handles claims?

Dillon
